structural-causal.basis: AI infrastructure requires specialized compute, switching and optical connectivity.

structural-causal.name: crossDivisionLeverage
structural-causal.basis: Custom silicon and connectivity IP can be co-designed around hyperscaler architectures.

structural-causal.name: bottleneckControl
structural-causal.basis: Electro-optics and custom silicon address bandwidth and specialized-compute constraints.

structural-causal.name: scenarioRobustness
structural-causal.basis: Connectivity and custom compute provide multiple AI paths, but data center is now 79% of revenue.

discovery-weak-signals.name: AI infrastructure exposure
discovery-weak-signals.basis: Record revenue and accelerating data-center growth.

discovery-weak-signals.name: AIConnectivityBreadth
discovery-weak-signals.basis: Marvell's September 2026 issuer releases describe an end-to-end AI data-center connectivity portfolio and new 2nm optical technology demonstrations spanning scale-up, scale-out and scale-across interconnect domains.

adversarial-red-team.name: scenarioRobustness
adversarial-red-team.basis: Strong AI demand is offset by heavy data-center and major-customer exposure.

adversarial-red-team.name: substitutionResilience
adversarial-red-team.basis: Deep custom integration raises switching friction, but customers can internalize or re-source designs.

adversarial-red-team.name: supplyChainResilience
adversarial-red-team.basis: Limited qualified advanced wafer, substrate, packaging and test suppliers are explicit dependencies.

adversarial-red-team.name: pricingPower
adversarial-red-team.basis: Record growth does not by itself establish durable program-level pricing power.

expectations-execution.name: Execution versus expectations
expectations-execution.basis: Revenue exceeded guidance midpoint and cash generation remained substantial.

expectations-execution.name: AdvancedNodeRoadmapExecution
expectations-execution.basis: The 2026-09-21 ECOC release extends Marvell's stated optical roadmap to multiple 2nm connectivity solutions after prior 5nm/3nm generations, providing current evidence of roadmap delivery cadence.

observedFacts: Marvell described AI connectivity products across PCIe scale-up switching, CXL memory, storage and Ethernet/optical connectivity.
The release frames connectivity as a constraint on bandwidth, latency, power and AI infrastructure utilization.
Marvell announced 2nm optical technology demonstrations for AI data-center infrastructure at ECOC 2026.
The portfolio includes optical PAM4, coherent-lite PAM4/IMDD and ZR/ZR+ coherent solutions targeted at higher-speed, lower-power interconnects.

unknowns.unknown: Customer-level concentration and security-level valuation are not established here.
No canonical live valuation input is asserted.
Program-level customer identities and economics are intentionally not inferred from aggregate bookings/design-win language.
Exact current revenue concentration by named hyperscaler is not asserted from the available lineage.

unknowns: No customer-specific volumes, pricing, market share or incremental revenue were disclosed in the releases.
Alpha retains factor scoring and valuation authority.
Production ramp dates and customer qualification status for each 2nm solution were not quantified.
